collection.title: VW Eos 2006 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW EOS Saloon 2006 to 2013 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
